{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check if conversion rate varies by channel
channel_conversion = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
channel_conversion['rate'] = channel_conversion['sum'] / channel_conversion['count']
print('Conversion rate by channel:')
print(channel_conversion[['rate']])

# Check if conversion rate varies by status
status_conversion = df.groupby('status')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
status_conversion['rate'] = status_conversion['sum'] / status_conversion['count']
print('\nConversion rate by status:')
print(status_conversion[['rate']])

# Check if conversion rate varies by age group (median split)
median_age = df['customer_age'].median()
df['age_group'] = pd.cut(df['customer_age'], bins=[0, median_age, 100], labels=['Young', 'Old'])
age_group_conversion = df.groupby('age_group')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
age_group_conversion['rate'] = age_group_conversion['sum'] / age_group_conversion['count']
print('\nConversion rate by age group:')
print(age_group_conversion[['rate']])"}
